name: ST NUCLEO-WBA55CG (Nucleo-64)
description: Newest STM32 wireless Nucleo-64: Cortex-M33 with TrustZone, Bluetooth 5.4 LE and 802.15.4 (Thread/Zigbee/Matter), PCB antenna and ST-LINK; the successor to the WB55 for new designs.
notes: Single-core Cortex-M33 runs both the application and the radio stack (unlike the dual-core WB55). 38 GPIO is an estimate for the UFQFPN48 part.
ST eStore price is high; Future, Arrow and Avnet listed about $58-61 in late 2026.
USB connector type for the ST-LINK port was not verified against the user manual.
